entries.zh: 一位年迈的贵妇人主持了慈善晚宴。

entries.en: The thesis analyzed archived cases of granulocytic leukemia.
entries.zh: 那篇学位论文分析了存档的粒细胞性白血病病例。

entries.en: The tropical medicine collection included a report on granuloma inguinale.
entries.zh: 热带医学文献集中收录了一份关于腹股沟肉芽肿的报告。

entries.en: The old journal contained an illustrated account of granuloma venereum.
entries.zh: 那本旧期刊载有一篇附图的性病肉芽肿记述。

entries.en: The tobacco field lost many plants to Granville wilt.
entries.zh: 那块烟田因烟青枯病损失了许多烟株。

entries.en: He spilled grapefruit juice over the breakfast menu.
entries.zh: 他把葡萄柚汁洒在了早餐菜单上。

entries.en: The sailor hauled a rusty grappling iron onto the deck.
entries.zh: 水手把一个生锈的钩锚拖上了甲板。

entries.en: The old novel portrayed a lonely grass widower.
entries.zh: 那部旧小说描写了一位孤独的离婚男子。

entries.en: Wild flowers covered the ancient grave mound.
entries.zh: 野花覆盖了那座古老的土冢。

entries.en: The old shrine contained a weathered graven image.
entries.zh: 那座古老的神龛里供着一尊风化的偶像。

entries.en: The damaged ferry spent six weeks in the graving dock.
entries.zh: 那艘受损的渡轮在干船坞里停了六周。

entries.en: The jeweler selected a narrow graving tool for the inscription.
entries.zh: 珠宝匠挑了一把窄头雕刻工具来刻字。

entries.en: The simulation increased the gravitational attraction between the two bodies.
entries.zh: 模拟增强了两个物体之间的万有引力。

entries.en: The survey team packed its gravity meter in a padded case.
entries.zh: 勘测队把重力仪装进了有衬垫的箱子里。

entries.en: A gray mullet darted beneath the harbor steps.
entries.zh: 一条鲻鱼从港口台阶下飞快游过。

entries.en: The historical account described the effects of grazing fire.
entries.zh: 那篇历史记述描写了低伸火力的影响。

entries.en: The family leased grazing land beyond the river.
entries.zh: 那家人在河对岸租了一片牧场。

entries.en: The atlas showed the greater omentum on a foldout page.
entries.zh: 图谱在一张折页上展示了大网膜。
